scope: Every arm runs all 84 original wire requests plus the unchanged context/paired-context protocol; no tool-order counterfactual enters this gate.
aggregation: Within each runtime, take the median per-case decode token/s across that runtime's repeated arms; the gate median is the median of these 84 per-case medians.
For each workload, take nearest-rank p95 of its per-case median decode milliseconds/token across repeated arms.
Report every arm independently alongside the aggregate; all four arms must complete all 84 role cases.
Acceptance ratios are reported per case/workload and for the depth probes, not assumed equal.
